req.title: Create task
req.statement: The system shall create a new task and respond with HTTP 201 and the created task body when POST /tasks/ receives a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected_outcomes: response body includes id, title, completed=false

doc.reasoning: The test suite covers POST /tasks/ for the FastAPI task manager. Positive case (EP) verifies HTTP 201 and correct response body fields using a standard valid payload. Boundary cases (BVA) test title at exactly 1 char (min) and exactly 100 chars (max), and description at exactly 500 chars (max), catching off-by-one mutations on Field constraints. Negative cases (NEG) test empty title (violates min_length=1), title exceeding 100 chars, description exceeding 500 chars, and missing required title field — all must return 422. A DT case verifies completed=true is persisted correctly (boolean invariant). Each test uses exact status code assertions and exact field-value checks to maximise mutation kill rate.

import sqlalchemy, os
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models

TEST_DB = "sqlite:///./test_r_task_001_pos.db"
engine = create_engine(TEST_DB, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

from app.database import get_db
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

def override_get_db():
    SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_payload_returns_201_with_body():
    payload = {"title": "Fix login bug", "description": "Some description", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] > 0
    assert body["title"] == "Fix login bug"
    assert body["description"] == "Some description"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "created_at" in body

test_create_task_valid_payload_returns_201_with_body()
os.remove("./test_r_task_001_pos.db") if os.path.exists("./test_r_task_001_pos.db") else None
